metadata.question: Does the active fire presence in La Palma, Spain decrease in July 17-18, 2023 compared to July 15-16, 2023?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use NASA MODIS MCD14DL thermal anomalies (MODIS/061/MCD14DL) as a robust global active fire point dataset. Filter by a polygon covering La Palma, Spain and two periods: 2023-07-15..17 and 2023-07-17..19 (end-exclusive).
2. Masking strategy: Not applicable; FIRMS/MODIS active fire detections are point features, not cloud-masked imagery.
3. Valid zero vs. null/error: A zero count is a valid “no fires detected”. If counts are null/NaN or any evaluation fails, return C3 or D as appropriate.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  // Helper to promisify evaluate/getInfo
  const evaluate = (eeObj) =>
    new Promise((resolve, reject) => eeObj.evaluate((v, e) => (e ? reject(e) : resolve(v))));

  // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
  // Approximate bounding polygon for La Palma, Spain (Canary Islands)
  const laPalma = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [
      [-18.10, 28.40],
      [-17.60, 28.40],
      [-17.60, 28.90],
      [-18.10, 28.90],
      [-18.10, 28.40],
    ],
  ]);

  const p1Start = '2023-07-15';
  const p1End = '2023-07-17'; // end-exclusive => covers 15-16
  const p2Start = '2023-07-17';
  const p2End = '2023-07-19'; // end-exclusive => covers 17-18

  // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
  // Use MODIS Thermal Anomalies and Fire (daily L2 points)
  const modisId = 'MODIS/061/MCD14DL';
  let modisOK = true;
  let p1Count = null;
  let p2Count = null;

  try {
    const fcP1 = ee
      .FeatureCollection(modisId)
      .filterDate(p1Start, p1End)
      .filterBounds(laPalma);
    const fcP2 = ee
      .FeatureCollection(modisId)
      .filterDate(p2Start, p2End)
      .filterBounds(laPalma);

    // Check that the global collection has data in those dates (not empty dataset)
    const globalP1Size = await evaluate(ee.FeatureCollection(modisId).filterDate(p1Start, p1End).size());
    const globalP2Size = await evaluate(ee.FeatureCollection(modisId).filterDate(p2Start, p2End).size());

    if (globalP1Size === 0 && globalP2Size === 0) {
      console.log('Global MODIS fire dataset empty for both periods (unexpected).');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }

    p1Count = await evaluate(fcP1.size());
    p2Count = await evaluate(fcP2.size());
  } catch (err) {
    modisOK = false;
    console.log(`MODIS retrieval error: ${String(err).slice(0, 120)}`);
  }

  if (!modisOK) {
    console.log('D');
    return;
  }

  // 3. Processing/Validation
  // No cloud masking applicable; zero detections are valid results.
  const invalidP1 = p1Count === null || Number.isNaN(p1Count);
  const invalidP2 = p2Count === null || Number.isNaN(p2Count);
  if (invalidP1 || invalidP2) {
    console.log(`Invalid calculation: P1=${p1Count}, P2=${p2Count}`);
    console.log('C3');
    return;
  }

  // 4. Evidence prints (concise, <=20 lines)
  console.log('Area: La Palma, Spain (bbox [-18.10,28.40] to [-17.60,28.90])');
  console.log(`MODIS MCD14DL detections 2023-07-15..17: ${p1Count}`);
  console.log(`MODIS MCD14DL detections 2023-07-17..19: ${p2Count}`);

  // 5. Final Decision
  // Decrease if P2 < P1
  const decreased = p2Count < p1Count;
  console.log(`Decrease: ${decreased ? 'Yes' : 'No'} (P1=${p1Count}, P2=${p2Count})`);
  console.log(decreased ? 'A' : 'B');
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
